title: Why Ezio Auditore became an Assassin in Assassin's Creed 2
subject: ezio
description:
Would you have trusted Uberto Alberti? 👇

How a banker's son from Florence became the most famous Assassin of the Renaissance. Spoilers for Assassin's Creed II.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubisoft. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Ezio Auditore was seventeen when Florence hanged his father and brothers.
In 1476 he was a banker's son, racing rooftops and brawling with Vieri de' Pazzi on the Ponte Vecchio.
Then guards took his father, Giovanni. Ezio carried the evidence to the man he trusted, Uberto Alberti.
On December 29, Uberto stood in the Piazza della Signoria and denied ever seeing it.
Giovanni, Federico and little Petruccio died on the gallows. From the crowd, Ezio shouted: I'll kill you for what you've done.
He kept that promise in the courtyard of Santa Croce, wearing his father's hidden blade.
